query: How many days of paid holiday do full-time staff get each year?

evidence.text: Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year

ground_truth: 25 days per calendar year plus public holidays; 28 days after five years of service.
notes: Manual practice item 1.

query: What is the daily meal limit when I'm travelling for work?

evidence.text: meals are reimbursed up to a daily limit of 60 euros

ground_truth: 60 euros per day (current policy, version 4). The archived 2021 policy said 45 euros; it no longer applies.
notes: Manual practice item 2. The archived policy is a trap: it quotes an old limit.

query: Until when can I use leave days I carried over from last year?

evidence.text: Carried-over days must be used by 31 March

ground_truth: By 31 March. Unused carried-over days are lost after that date.

query: I got sick in the middle of my vacation - can I get those days back?

evidence.text: can reclassify those days as sick leave

ground_truth: Yes. Tell your manager on the first day of illness and send a medical certificate; the days return to your leave balance.
notes: User says 'vacation' and 'get back'; the document says 'reclassify'.

query: By what time must I tell my manager I'm too unwell to come in?

evidence.text: before 9:30 on the first day of absence

ground_truth: Before 9:30 on the first day of absence, by phone or message.

query: Do I need a doctor's note if I'm off sick for ten days?

evidence.text: For absences longer than seven calendar days, you must provide a fit note from a doctor

ground_truth: Yes. Absences longer than seven calendar days need a fit note from a doctor.
notes: 'doctor's note' vs 'fit note'.

query: How many working days of full pay do I get when I'm sick?

evidence.text: full pay for up to 20 working days of sickness in any rolling 12-month period

ground_truth: Up to 20 working days of full pay in a rolling 12 months, then 20 days at half pay.

query: How many weeks at full salary does the birth parent receive?

evidence.text: Kestrel pays the first 18 weeks at full salary

ground_truth: The first 18 weeks are paid at full salary.

query: My wife is having a baby - how much time off can I take and is it paid?

evidence.text: is entitled to 4 weeks of partner leave at full pay

ground_truth: 4 weeks of partner leave at full pay, in one block or two blocks of 2 weeks, within 6 months of the birth.
notes: The user never says 'partner leave'.

query: Can I do some work while on maternity leave without it ending?

evidence.text: you may work up to 10 keeping-in-touch days without ending your leave

ground_truth: Yes, up to 10 voluntary keeping-in-touch days, paid at your normal daily rate.
notes: 'maternity leave' vs 'parental leave' and 'keeping-in-touch days'.

query: Which weekdays do we have to be in the office?

evidence.text: on at least two anchor days per week, Tuesday and Thursday

ground_truth: Tuesday and Thursday are the anchor days (a team can agree a different anchor day with its department head).
notes: The facilities guide mentions anchor days but does not say which days - judged not relevant.

query: Can I work from a beach in Spain for a month?

evidence.text: is allowed for up to 20 working days in a calendar year

ground_truth: Only up to 20 working days per calendar year from outside your country of employment, approved in advance by the People Team.
notes: No shared keywords: 'beach in Spain' vs 'outside your country of employment'.

query: Will the company pay for my home broadband?

evidence.text: The company does not reimburse home internet, electricity or heating costs

ground_truth: No, unless your contract makes you home-based; home-based staff get 40 euros per month.
notes: 'broadband' vs 'internet'.

query: How much can I claim for a desk chair for working from home?

evidence.text: a one-off home office allowance of 300 euros

ground_truth: A one-off 300 euro home office allowance, claimed within six months of starting hybrid work.

query: Which form do I fill in after losing a receipt?

evidence.text: complete the missing receipt declaration form FIN-17

ground_truth: Form FIN-17, the missing receipt declaration (at most three times per year).

query: What is the rate per km for using my own car on business?

evidence.text: reimbursed at 0.30 euros per kilometre

ground_truth: 0.30 euros per kilometre. Commuting is not a business journey.
notes: The archived policy says 0.25 - a stale-version trap.

query: How long do I have to submit an expense claim?

evidence.text: within 60 days of the date the cost was incurred

ground_truth: 60 days from the date of the cost.

query: When am I allowed to fly premium economy?

evidence.text: Premium economy may be booked for flights with a scheduled duration of more than 6 hours

ground_truth: For flights scheduled to last more than 6 hours.

query: What's the hotel budget per night in Zurich?

evidence.text: 220 euros per night in high-cost cities such as London, Zurich and New York

ground_truth: 220 euros per night (high-cost city).

query: Can I book a cheaper flight on another website and still get my money back?

evidence.text: Bookings made elsewhere will only be reimbursed if they are at least 15% cheaper

ground_truth: Only if it is at least 15% cheaper than the lowest TravelDesk fare, with a screenshot of that fare attached.

query: I want to stay a few extra days on holiday after a work trip - who pays for what?

evidence.text: provided the extra days do not increase the cost to the company
Personal trips added to a business trip are not covered for the personal days

ground_truth: You may add personal days if they add no cost; you pay any extra cost, and the personal days are not insured. Book the days off as annual leave.

query: I left my work laptop on the train. What should I do?

evidence.text: report it to the IT Service Desk within one hour of noticing

ground_truth: Report it to the IT Service Desk within one hour; also report it to the police and send the report number.

query: How long does my account password have to be?

evidence.text: Use a password of at least 14 characters

ground_truth: At least 14 characters, plus multi-factor authentication.

query: I clicked a link in a dodgy email by accident. Will I be punished?

evidence.text: no disciplinary action will be taken for honest mistakes that are reported promptly

ground_truth: No, if you report it promptly with the Report Phishing button.
notes: 'dodgy email' vs 'phishing'; 'punished' vs 'disciplinary action'.

query: A supplier offered me a 40 euro shopping voucher. Can I keep it?

evidence.text: Cash, vouchers and gift cards must never be accepted, whatever the amount

ground_truth: No. Vouchers are never accepted, even under the 50 euro gift limit.
notes: Hard because the 50 euro rule seems to allow it; the voucher rule overrides it.

query: Do I have to tell anyone if my brother works for a competitor?

evidence.text: Declare any potential conflict of interest to your manager and the Legal team

ground_truth: Yes. Declare it as a potential conflict of interest to your manager and Legal using the compliance portal form.

query: When do pay rises from the annual review start?

evidence.text: take effect on 1 March

ground_truth: On 1 March.

query: How long do I have to appeal a performance rating I disagree with?

evidence.text: within 14 days of receiving the rating

ground_truth: Ask your manager's manager for a review within 14 days of receiving the rating.
notes: 'appeal' vs 'ask for a review'.

query: What do I need to bring on my first day?

evidence.text: Bring a photo identity document

ground_truth: A photo identity document, for the right-to-work check.

query: How long is probation and what is the notice period during it?

evidence.text: The probation period lasts six months
During probation, the notice period on either side is two weeks

ground_truth: Six months, with two weeks' notice on either side during probation.
notes: The sick leave policy mentions probation (sick pay starts after it) - related, grade 1.

query: If I put 8% of my salary into the pension, how much does Kestrel add?

evidence.text: if you contribute 8%, the company contributes 6%

ground_truth: 6% - the company matches up to 6% of basic salary.

query: Does private medical insurance pay for new glasses?

evidence.text: Dental and optical treatment are not included in the medical insurance
refunds part of the cost of routine dental check-ups, eye tests and glasses

ground_truth: No, but the dental and optical cash plan refunds up to 400 euros per year, including glasses.
notes: The literal answer is 'no'; the useful answer is in another section.

query: Can I report fraud without giving my name?

evidence.text: Reports to the hotline can be made anonymously

ground_truth: Yes, through the independent Speak-Up hotline, by phone or website.
notes: 'without giving my name' vs 'anonymously'.

query: How quickly will I hear back after raising a concern?

evidence.text: Every report is acknowledged within 7 days

ground_truth: Acknowledged within 7 days; feedback on the outcome within three months where possible.

query: What courses must a new hire finish in the first month, and is there money for extra training?

evidence.text: must complete four online courses within 30 days of starting
a personal learning budget of 1,000 euros per calendar year

ground_truth: Four mandatory online courses within 30 days; plus a 1,000 euro yearly learning budget.

query: When can I change my pension contribution or buy extra holiday days?

evidence.text: You can change your contribution rate once a month in the benefits portal
employees may buy up to five additional days of leave through salary sacrifice

ground_truth: Pension: once a month in the benefits portal. Extra leave: up to five days, only in the November benefits window.
notes: The newsletter mentions the benefits window but gives no rule - judged not relevant.

query: What security rules do I have to follow when working from home?

evidence.text: you must connect to company systems only through the company VPN

ground_truth: Use the VPN, no public computers, lock your screen, do not print confidential papers at home; plus the general IT Security Policy (passwords, MFA).

query: What's the daily allowance on a business trip and does it include food?

evidence.text: you may claim a per diem of 45 euros
The per diem does not cover meals
meals are reimbursed up to a daily limit of 60 euros

ground_truth: 45 euros per full day for incidentals, excluding meals; meals are claimed separately up to 60 euros per day.
notes: Trap: the archived policy's meal limit is also 45 euros.

query: What is the company policy on bringing dogs to the office?
ground_truth: Not covered by any document in the corpus.
notes: Unanswerable on purpose - tests abstention, excluded from retrieval metrics.

query: Is there a company car scheme for managers?
ground_truth: Not covered by any document in the corpus.
notes: Unanswerable on purpose - the benefits overview has no car scheme.
